messages:
emma_cs: Hey team — Brightline Health renewal in ~3 weeks. They flagged latency variance and asked for a formal SLA report + possible credit. Onboarding still has 2 connectors not finished which is contributing to routing fallbacks. Can we align on uptime/latency numbers to share with them? cc @marcus_sales @leo_se

marcus_sales: Thanks — do we have the official 90d uptime %? They keep referencing a 99.9 target.

emma_cs: Quick snapshot from observability for the last 90d:
```
90d:
  uptime: 99.87%
  p95_latency_ms (gen endpoints): 310
  incidents_over_90d: 2
```
Two onboarding connectors are still queued which forced traffic to fallback region during peak — that explains the p95 spikes. I'll include these notes in the customer doc.

leo_se: Ok — fallback routing looks like config + missing connector routing rules. I can triage with eng-infra this morning. Short mitigation: pin Brightline traffic to us-west and enable prefix cache TTL=30s. Should drop p95 by ~40-60ms while we finish connectors.

olivia_support: I have the ticket list for those connectors: #5123 (auth handshake) and #5178 (schema mismatch). Reassigning to eng-oncall and adding status lines to the report.

sre-bot: incident notice: INC-2026-1221 — elevated latency in us-east on 2026-12-04T09:12Z, automated post to channel.

marcus_sales: For credits — contract is enterprise-dedicated and includes uptime credit tiers. If confirmed 99.87 < 99.9 for the quarter, recommend we pre-propose a 5% service credit for the quarter and show the remediation plan. Thoughts?

gwen_finance: I can pull the exact ARR/MRR for Brightline and validate the credit math. Will DM the revenue numbers and confirm by EOD.

leo_se: I'll apply the routing pin now and run before/after p95 tests. Expect initial improvements within ~4h; will post results here.

emma_cs: Thanks all. Plan: 1) Leo pushes fix, 2) Olivia updates ticket notes, 3) Gwen confirms credit calc, 4) I draft the customer-facing SLA report with metrics + mitigation steps + proposed 5% credit, then route to @marcus_sales and legal for sign-off. Can enablement schedule a 30m post-fix review for the Brightline ops team? :calendar:  

marcus_sales: :thumbsup: aiming for Tue 10am PT for the session.

emma_cs: I'll post the draft in this thread once I have numbers from Leo and Gwen. Thanks everyone.
